name: Vesicular-Doxology
description: Sand owns this world, in colors from bone-white to burnt sienna, migrating with the seasons before a patient wind. Where the gusts strip it away, towering mountain ranges emerge like the bones of the planet.

Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound. Mats of pigment-bearing microbes stain the wet stone in bands of rust and violet.
Established during the last boom, the automated beacon of unknown purpose was never decommissioned. Its roster lists eleven souls; life-support draws power for thirty.
Business at the outpost is steady and deniable. Newcomers are welcome, watched, and priced accordingly.
